hook_text: BA is down 10.7% today after making $60M operating profit on $95B of sales.
audio_script: [BEAT: hook] Boeing is down ten point seven percent today, with sixty million dollars of operating profit on ninety five billion of sales [BEAT: headline] Revenue missed estimates, though quarterly cash flow hit three hundred thirty two million. [BEAT: move] Shares fell to one sixty eight on seven times volume. [BEAT: turn] But here is the part nobody screenshots. [BEAT: numbers] Revenue rose from sixty two billion to ninety five billion. Operating income barely scraped sixty million. Free cash flow burned three fifty seven million. Diluted shares [CURIOUS] jumped from five eighty eight million to seven eighty eight million, as the planes stay grounded while the share count flies. [BEAT: numbers_comment] Gross margin sits in the fourth percentile, so dilution funds the factory. [BEAT: cheap_or_trap] Debt fell, yet seventy times EBITDA assumes nine point four percent perpetual cash growth. [BEAT] Cheap needs deliveries to double. [BEAT: conclusion] Mostly noise, one number worth watching. Until yearly free cash flow stays positive, it is a repair job priced like a growth stock.

headlines.text: Boeing Q4 FY25 revenue $24.19B vs $24.37B consensus
headlines.meaning: Missed top-line estimates by $180M and posted another $116M quarterly net loss.

headlines.text: Quarterly free cash flow turns positive at $332M
headlines.meaning: One positive quarter after burning $912M the prior quarter is a pulse, not a turnaround.

numbers_comment: Gross margin sits in the fourth percentile, so dilution funds the factory.
turn_line: But here is the part nobody screenshots.
cheap_or_trap: At 69.7x EV/EBITDA (98th percentile vs peers), the price implies 9.4% perpetual FCF growth vs -19.2% delivered. Cheap needs deliveries to double cleanly.
conclusion: Mostly noise, one number worth watching. Until yearly free cash flow stays positive, it is a repair job priced like a growth stock.
